## Companies mining uranium in Kazakhstan (2023)

The table below (from the USGS Minerals Yearbook 2023) lists all uranium-mining facilities, their operators, and the ownership shares that were reported at the time. Capacity figures are plant capacities, not actual production.

| Operator | Owner(s) and stake (exact wording) | Location | Capacity |
|---|---|---|---|
| Akbastau JV | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 50%, and Uranium One Inc., 50%” | Blocks 1, 3 and 4 of the Budenovskoe deposit, Sozak Region, Turkistan Province | 24 000 t |
| APPAK LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 65%; Sumitomo Corp., 25%; Kansai Electric Power Co. Inc., 10%” | West site of Mynkuduk deposit, Sozak Region, Turkistan Province | 24 000 t |
| Baiken-U LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 52.5%, and Energy Asia (BVI) Ltd., 47.5%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| JV Akbastau JSC | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 50%, and One Group JSC, 50%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| JV Budyonovskoye LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 51%, and Stepnogorsk Mining and Chemical Plant LLP, 49%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| JV Inkai LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 60%, and Cameco Corp., 40%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| JV Katco LLP | “JSC ORANO Mining, 51%, and NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 49%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| JV Khorasan-U LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 50%; Energy Asia Holding Ltd., 20%, and Uranium One Utercht B.V., 30%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| JV Southern Mining and Chemical Co. (SMCC LLP) | “Uranium One Rotterdam B.V., 70%, and NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 30%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| Karatau LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 50%, and Uranium One Netherlands B.V. PLLC” | ... | 24 000 t |
| Kazatomprom-SaUran LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 100%” | ... | 24 000 t |
| Kyzylkum LLP | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 50%; Japanese consortium, 30%; UraniumOne Inc., 20%” | ... | 24 000 t |

| JV Zarechnoe JSC | “NAC Kazatomprom JSC, 49.98%; JV Zarechoe JSC, 49.98; and JSC Kara-Balta Mining Plant, 0.04%” | ... | 24 000 t |

The table shows 17 distinct operators; the majority are joint-ventures that include NAC Kazatomprom JSC as a 50–100 % stakeholder. The largest single stake listed is 100 % NAC Kazatomprom JSC (e.g., Kazatomprom-SaUran LLP). All capacity figures are in metric tons.

Who do they sell to? The Substrata database does not contain buyer or offtake information for Kazakhstan’s uranium output.

The missing link: To determine the buyers of Kazakhstan’s uranium, you would need offtake and supply agreements disclosed in the operators’ annual reports and filings, customs and trade records (e.g., UN Comtrade), or the buyers’ own procurement disclosures.
